_comment: Known-issue baseline for the feed validation gate (scripts/validate-feeds.sh).
The gate fails when a validator reports an ERROR code that is NOT listed here.
It deliberately does not gate on occurrence COUNTS: those track how many trains
are running and fluctuate legitimately between runs. A new error CODE is a real
regression; a changing count is not.
Entries here are owned, review-dated technical debt rather than permanent exemptions.
Remove a code once it is fixed so the gate ratchets tighter; expired records fail closed.

static._note: Amtrak's official GTFS currently produces zero ERROR notices, so any error here is a genuine regression.

allowed_errors.upstream_cause: Amtrak operates extra sections and trains absent from the published schedule.
Realtime route identifiers accompany trips absent from the published schedule.
Live data references stations missing from the static feed.
Upstream Amtrak estimates are not always temporally increasing.
Upstream Amtrak estimates can place departure before arrival.
Vehicle coordinates can be far from the published trip shape.
Upstream trip and route matching can disagree with the static schedule.
The legacy transform retained deletion markers in a FULL_DATASET feed.
The legacy transform emitted trains with no remaining predicted stops.
Some upstream stop updates omit both arrival and departure predictions.
The legacy transform omitted explicit feed incrementality.
